title: Fix Sketchpad Detail Panel Input Fields Expand Collapse and Multi-Selection
description: Fix sketchpad details panel input fields: single-line collapsed with ellipsis by default, expand on click/focus, collapse on blur. Handle multi-selection mixed state, consistent spacing, no overlaps.
summary: Updated shared labeled detail fields to render as measured single-line collapsed displays with word-boundary ellipsis, expanding back to the real input/textarea on focus. Tightened sketchpad detail-panel sizing rules so collapsed textareas stay one row and expanded textareas do not overlap adjacent fields. Added regression coverage for the truncation helper and detail-panel description-field layout transitions. Verification: `npm test --workspace elements/ui` passed (9 tests). Targeted sketchpad Playwright Design run collected and executed but failed before the new assertions because the page crashed during existing app initialization while navigating to `http://127.0.0.1:5173/`.
